catalog.descriptionAr: احتفل بخطوبتك مع تشكيلة مختارة من الأغاني الرومانسية والحماسية، وصوت وإضاءة بجودة عالية تصنع الأجواء المثالية للعائلة والأصدقاء.

catalog.descriptionAr: من حفلات الأطفال إلى أعياد الميلاد المميزة، نوفّر الموسيقى والصوت والإضاءة لتبقى أجواء الاحتفال حاضرة لكل الضيوف.

catalog.descriptionAr: رؤوس متحركة وهياكل وإضاءة لاسلكية للأجواء.

catalog.name: Other
catalog.description: Have a different occasion in mind? Tell us about your event and we'll tailor the music, sound and lighting to fit it.
catalog.descriptionAr: لديك مناسبة أخرى؟ أخبرنا عن فعاليتك وسنصمّم الموسيقى والصوت والإضاءة بما يناسبها.

equipment.name: Shure Wireless Receiver
equipment.description: Single-channel wireless microphone receiver with a black enclosure, front-panel group and channel controls, green status indicators and an A1 display.
equipment.functionSummary: Receives wireless microphone audio for the sound system.

equipment.name: Wedge-shaped floor monitors
equipment.description: Angled speakers that sit on the stage floor and point back at performers, so singers, speakers and live musicians can hear themselves clearly. They keep performances on pitch and on time without raising the volume for your guests. Ideal for events with live bands, vocalists or speeches.
equipment.functionSummary: Lets performers and speakers hear themselves clearly on stage.

equipment.name: Tall floor-standing speakers
equipment.description: Full-range speakers that stand at floor level and deliver clear, room-filling sound for both music and speeches. Their tall profile spreads audio evenly across the space, so guests at the back hear as well as those up front. A great fit for mid-size venues and ballrooms.
equipment.functionSummary: Fills the room with clear, even sound for music and speeches.

equipment.name: Sound system subwoofers
equipment.description: Dedicated low-frequency speakers that add deep, punchy bass to your music. They take the heavy lifting off the main speakers, so the whole system sounds fuller and cleaner at any volume. Essential for a dance floor you can feel as well as hear.
equipment.functionSummary: Adds deep, powerful bass to the music.

equipment.name: Intelligent Moving Heads
equipment.description: Computer-controlled lights that pan, tilt and change colour and pattern in sync with the music. They create dynamic beams and sweeping effects that turn any dance floor into a show. Perfect for adding concert-style energy to weddings, parties and corporate events.
equipment.functionSummary: Creates moving beams, colours and patterns synced to the music.

equipment.name: Pole-mounted speakers
equipment.description: Speakers mounted on stands or subwoofer poles so the sound travels above the crowd instead of being blocked by guests. This raised position gives even coverage across the room with a clean, compact setup. Well suited to receptions, corporate events and outdoor gatherings.
equipment.functionSummary: Projects sound above the crowd for even coverage across the room.

equipment.name: Base Plates / Trussing
equipment.description: Sturdy metal truss structures and base plates used to mount lighting, speakers and décor safely above the floor. They give your setup a clean, professional stage look while keeping equipment secure. Ideal for building a lighting rig, DJ booth frame or stage backdrop.
equipment.functionSummary: Holds lights, speakers and décor securely above the floor.

equipment.name: Uplights
equipment.description: Compact LED lights placed along walls, pillars or the edges of the room to wash the space in colour. They transform a venue’s atmosphere instantly and can be matched to your theme or wedding colours. An affordable way to make any room feel elegant and polished.
equipment.functionSummary: Washes walls and pillars in colour to set the mood of the room.

equipment.name: 12-inch powered speakers
equipment.description: Professional self-powered QSC speakers known for clear, natural sound and dependable performance. Versatile enough for background music, speeches or a lively dance floor in small to medium spaces. Built-in amplification keeps the setup tidy and quick to install.
equipment.functionSummary: Delivers clear, balanced sound for small to medium spaces.

equipment.name: 15-inch speakers
equipment.description: Larger-format speakers with a 15-inch driver for extra volume and fuller low end. They give more punch and reach than smaller speakers, making them ideal for bigger rooms and higher-energy parties. They can run on their own or with a subwoofer for even more impact.
equipment.functionSummary: Provides louder, fuller sound for larger rooms and dance floors.

equipment.name: 18-inch subwoofer
equipment.description: A powerful 18-inch subwoofer that delivers the deep, chest-thumping bass a high-energy dance floor needs. It pairs with our main speakers to complete the sound and bring the music to life. Recommended for weddings, parties and any event where dancing is the focus.
equipment.functionSummary: Produces heavy, chest-thumping bass for high-energy dancing.

equipment.name: Vocal microphones
equipment.description: Industry-trusted Shure microphones that make speeches, toasts and vocals sound clear and natural. Built to reject background noise and handle live use reliably. Perfect for MCs, wedding speeches, presentations and live singers.
equipment.functionSummary: Picks up voices clearly for speeches, announcements and singing.

equipment.name: Mixing console
equipment.description: A professional Soundcraft mixer that blends microphones, music and instruments into one balanced sound. It gives precise control over volume and tone for every input throughout your event. Essential when you have multiple speakers, performers or live musicians.
equipment.functionSummary: Blends and balances all microphones, music and instruments into one sound.

equipment.name: Smoke Machine
equipment.description: Produces a light haze that makes lighting beams and effects pop through the air. It adds depth and atmosphere to the dance floor and stage, especially when paired with moving-head lights. Output is adjustable, so it stays subtle and comfortable for guests.
equipment.functionSummary: Fills the air with light haze so lighting beams and effects stand out.

equipment.name: Sparklers / Cold Spark Effects
equipment.description: Fountains of cool-to-the-touch sparks that create a dramatic, firework-style moment without real fire or smoke. Safer for indoor venues and perfect for grand entrances, first dances, cake cutting or a big reveal. They make for unforgettable photos and videos.
equipment.functionSummary: Shoots cool, safe spark fountains for dramatic special moments.

equipment.name: Dry Ice Machine
equipment.description: Creates a thick, low-lying cloud that rolls across the floor for the famous “dancing on the clouds” effect. The fog hugs the ground and doesn’t rise to fill the room. A magical touch for a first dance, grand entrance or stage reveal.
equipment.functionSummary: Creates a low-lying cloud of fog across the floor for a "dancing on the clouds" effect.

equipment.name: CO₂ Gun With Tank
equipment.description: A handheld cannon that shoots powerful bursts of cold CO₂ vapour into the air for an instant energy spike. A crowd favourite at peak moments on the dance floor, timed to the big drops in the music. Comes with its own tank and is operated by our crew for safety.
equipment.functionSummary: Blasts bursts of cold CO₂ vapour into the air at peak moments of the party.

equipment.name: LED Screen
equipment.description: A bright, high-resolution video wall built from six LED panels, visible even in well-lit rooms. Use it for slideshows, live video, logos, visuals or a personalized welcome message. It makes a striking centrepiece behind the DJ booth or stage.
equipment.functionSummary: Displays bright video, slideshows, logos and visuals that are visible even in daylight.

equipment.name: Projector
equipment.description: A projector for displaying slideshows, videos, presentations or custom visuals on a screen or wall. A simple, budget-friendly way to share photos and memories or show branded content. Great for weddings, birthdays and corporate events.
equipment.functionSummary: Projects photos, videos and presentations onto a screen or wall.
